Bringing in his lecture P D Fs? Premium too.

text: And for the first time, he could see it.
But his notes couldn't hold it. A screenshot froze it.
The part that made it click was gone.
So he asked a different question.
Night after night, they built it together.
Ink that keeps up with a pen. Pages that never go black.
Then the first live page ran, right between his notes.
And he could still write on top of it.
Record a lecture, and tap any stroke to hear that moment.
Hide a word under tape, and it becomes a flashcard. Sync only if you want, encrypted first.
That student is Archishman. He asked Claude, and together they built OpenNote.

text: Free. No ads. No account. On the web, Android and Windows.
